test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Obsession
solution:
The correct answer is: Fascination.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Obsession"** means an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind. (जुनून)

 
 
• **Example:** His **obsession **with cleanliness made it difficult for him to relax.
 
 
 
• **"Fascination"** refers to the state of being intensely interested or attracted to something. (मोह)
 
 
• **Example:** The **fascination **with space exploration has led to many scientific discoveries.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Discrimination** (भेदभाव): The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people or things, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.

 
 
• **Example:** The company was accused of **discrimination **against older workers.
 
 
 
• **Unconcern** (उदासीनता): A lack of worry or interest, especially when it is surprising or callous.
 
 
• **Example:** His **unconcern **for the poor conditions of the workers was shocking.
 
 
 
• **Sympathy** (सहानुभूति): Feelings of pity and sorrow for someone else's misfortune.
 
 
• **Example:** She expressed her **sympathy **to the family of the deceased.
